items.title: Why the AFL tribunal upheld Neale's grand final ban

children.content: After a tribunal hearing lasting four and half hours, Lachie Neale remains banned from the grand final against his old side Fremantle, with the AFL world now waiting to hear if the Lions will launch an appeal.
